app.name: memrrtiks, suashem
app.long_description:
Everybody's favourite schizophrenia simulator is now on the Wii!
Play with all the features you know and love from the Flash version, including: - bright lights - a "soundtrack" (generous naming) - funky backgrounds - seizures
Have fun! UPDATE v1.01 10/2: attempt fix for main menu dithering, remove unused sprite, use SYS_MainLoop UPDATE v1.02 10/2: fix main menu dithering (for REAL this time) UPDATE v1.03 5/4: GameCube controller support (port 1 only)
